hypothesis: If frozen INT8 H3 produces all thirty layer-aligned current-observation K/V prefixes online while FACT future/state/value tracks update those same thirty ActionDiT blocks, then future-prediction supervision will improve episode-disjoint action conditioning without the train/deploy gap of stored H3 features.
single_variable: Relative to C58 online frozen-H3 action training, add FACT clean-action, future-H3, future-state and value tracks plus official failure action masks inside the same thirty ActionDiT blocks; H3 checkpoint, online packing, action contract, dense windows and optimizer parent remain fixed.

architecture.field: online frozen world prefix and shared action/consequence blocks
architecture.paper: P/A/G/V/I use one causal video transformer and future losses update the action-generating backbone.
architecture.upstream_code: One Wan causal transformer runs teacher-forced tracks; VAE latents may be cached but transformer K/V is not a training dataset artifact.
architecture.local: C56b shared30 tower exists; the online frozen INT8 H3 provider that must supply exact layer-aligned K/V is pending the fixed C58 interface.
architecture.rationale: No duplicate online provider will be invented before C58 fixes its API and commit identity.

data.field: expert, observational and causal-failure online inputs
data.paper: Expert and failure episodes share one transformed dataset; failure actions are masked.
data.upstream_code: EpisodeMixtureSampler chooses dataset, episode, then frame; WATransforms accepts online images or cached VAE latents.
data.local: Expert rows return existing VAE current/future latents; C48/C59 and C60 return current/future RGB from immutable trajectories. No row contains H3 K/V or H3 features.
data.rationale: Only the VAE boundary differs by stream; frozen H3 executes online for both and the collator forbids cached H3 fields.

action.field: LIBERO horizon32 absolute 7D and failure imitation mask
action.paper: Failed episode actions are excluded from imitation while future/value remain supervised.
action.upstream_code: action_loss_mask is zero for failure episodes.
action.local: C48 consumes audited C59 labels and C60 consumes embedded causal labels; environment/dataset gripper conversion is round-trip tested.
action.rationale: LIBERO absolute 7D horizon32 replaces RoboTwin delta14 horizon48 while retaining the deployed D0 action contract.

objective.paper: Action, future image, future state and value flow losses jointly update one backbone.
objective.upstream_code: wa_casual_trainer.py applies the four objectives and action failure mask.
objective.local: C56b loss/tower code exists, but the future-H3 online target adapter and distinct future-state mask integration await C58 online output contract.
objective.rationale: Target width/normalization must be derived from the fixed online provider rather than guessed.

optimization.paper: Long multi-GPU training with separate parameter groups.
optimization.upstream_code: Resolved FACT config uses distributed training and episode mixture sampling.
optimization.local: Launcher is hard-gated on a fixed C58 online commit, provider symbol, GO_LONG dossier and absent output root.
optimization.rationale: Microbatch, seconds/step, effective epochs and memory remain unknown until the online provider can run a bounded probe.

evaluation.field: paired offline mechanism and fresh LIBERO closed loop
evaluation.upstream_code: Action generation is evaluated before consequence/value selection.
evaluation.local: C58 online is the fixed action-only parent; C56b must first preserve action conditioning and then beat it on fresh episode-disjoint LIBERO trials.
evaluation.rationale: LIBERO replaces RoboTwin and no effectiveness claim is made before paired rollout.
